description.zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 一次最多可以传500个域名。
description.en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

> You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request.

description.zh:
获取数据的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获取，不传该参数默认查询所有运营商。
description.en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP).

If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is queried. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query ISP names.

description.zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获取，不传该参数默认查询所有地域。
description.en:
The name of the region.

If you do not set this parameter, data in all regions is queried. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query regions.

description.zh:
获取数据的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.zh: - 如果您不指定StartTime和EndTime，该接口默认返回过去1小时的数据；指定StartTime和EndTime，该接口返回指定时间段的数据。
descriptions.en:
- Each account can call this operation up to 10 times per second.

- If you do not set the StartTime or EndTime parameter, the request returns the data collected in the last hour. If you set both these parameters, the request returns the data collected within the specified time range.

**Time granularity**

The time granularity varies with the time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters. The following table describes the time period within which historical data is available and the data delay.

| Time granularity | Maximum time range per query | Historical data available | Data delay |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------- |
| 1 minute         | 1 hour                       | 7 days                    | 5 minutes  |
| 5 minutes        | 3 days                       | 93 days                   | 15 minutes |
| 1 hour           | 31 days                      | 186 days                  | 4 hours    |

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-domain-real-time-qps-data --domain-name example.com --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --start-time 2019-12-02T11:25:00Z --end-time 2019-12-02T11:26:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainRealTimeQpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2019-12-02T11:26:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2019-12-02T11:25:00Z'
